description.p: Scene is a keyboard-first launcher for Linux. Activate it, type, and it ranks installed applications, folders, links, and its own commands in one deterministic list.

System actions are typed and bounded rather than free-form shell commands. Every command Scene will run is shown before it runs, work that changes the system is confirmed first and escalates through the desktop's own authorisation agent, and the launcher reports what it actually observed: an unavailable tool, a permission failure, a timeout, a cancellation, or a non-zero exit.
Package search, metadata, installed-package and update queries work through capability adapters for the Debian, Fedora and Arch families, detected by the tools that are really on PATH.
Pre-release development builds. Not yet packaged for a distribution.
